description: Verifies the dark matter field of the renderer and the N-body coupling: enclosed mass fractions of every profile, triaxial ellipsoidal geometry, gravitational acceleration and lensing scale, photon deflection and step limit, volumetric emission, settings serialization, anchor resolution, subhalo population generation and presets.

checks.label: the enclosed mass fraction vanishes at the centre for every profile
the enclosed mass fraction is non-negative and non-decreasing for every profile
the derivative of the enclosed fraction is non-negative for every profile
the local x coordinate equals the offset from the halo centre
the local y coordinate equals the offset from the halo centre
the local z coordinate equals the offset from the halo centre
the ellipsoidal radius divides each axis by its axis ratio
the acceleration points toward the point mass
the acceleration has no transverse component on the axis
the magnitude equals M / r^2
the lensing scale multiplies the acceleration when requested
the kick rotates the photon direction without changing its speed
the kick bends the photon toward the halo
the step limit is positive
the step limit does not exceed the step fraction times the distance
the emission vanishes while visualization is disabled
the emission is positive in every channel inside the halo
the emission vanishes beyond the truncation radius
the first halo is stored at index zero
the total halo mass equals the stored mass
the profile normalization is positive
the mass enclosed at the scale radius lies strictly between zero and the total mass
the circular velocity and the density at the scale radius are positive
the enable flag and the halo count survive serialization
the field scalars survive serialization
the name, profile and anchor of the halo survive serialization
every scalar halo parameter survives serialization
the tint survives serialization at single precision
the anchored halo is accepted
the resolved field keeps the anchor and the body coupling flag
the halo follows its anchor body plus the offset advanced by its velocity
the anchor body feels no force from its own halo
a different body feels the halo
the generator spawns the requested number of subhalos
every subhalo mass lies in the configured range
every subhalo lies in the configured shell
every preset has a positive mass, scale radius and normalization
